item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect mostly cloudy to cloudy skies across the region with low temperatures ranging from the mid forties to the upper forties and a chance of light rain, especially late, with precipitation chances between fifteen and forty percent. Saturday brings cloudy or mostly cloudy skies and high temperatures from the mid fifties to the upper fifties, with rain likely in most areas and precipitation chances climbing to between forty-seven and seventy-two percent. Saturday night, rain continues under cloudy skies with lows in the mid thirties to upper thirties and precipitation chances as high as ninety-three percent, with rainfall totals reaching up to half an inch in some spots.
